body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21 ~07:45Z, my own miss). I verified that "mod admission_deadline" and "mod relay_production_shape" existed, then passed the author's filter tests::federation_native_binding_proof::relay_production_shape::admission_deadline:: to a runner. It selected ZERO tests (3BDD-RED-1, test-1e440859), because relay_production_shape is declared inside relay.rs, so the real path has one more level: ...::federation_native_binding_proof::relay::relay_production_shape::admission_deadline::. Rule: before sending any cargo test filter, resolve the WHOLE module chain from src/tests/mod.rs downwards (each "mod X;" or #[path] declaration and the file that declares it), or use git grep to find the parent of every module in the filter. Finding the leaf "mod" declaration alone is not enough. A zero selection is a STOP, never a pass.
